import math
import unittest

from solution import read_ruled_grid


class ReadRuledGridTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rectangular_grid_includes_empty_cells(self):
        rows = [0, 10, 20]
        columns = [0, 5, 10]
        labels = [(1, 1, "a"), (6, 15, "b")]
        self.assertEqual(read_ruled_grid(rows, columns, labels), [["a", ""], ["", "b"]])

    def test_reading_order_is_y_then_x_with_stable_ties(self):
        labels = [
            (8, 2, "third"),
            (9, 1, "second"),
            (1, 1, "first"),
            (1, 1, "first-tie"),
            (0, 9, "fourth"),
        ]
        result = read_ruled_grid([0, 10], [0, 10], labels)
        self.assertEqual(result, [["first first-tie second third fourth"]])

    def test_half_open_bounds_and_internal_edges(self):
        labels = [
            (-0.01, 1, "left-out"),
            (1, -0.01, "top-out"),
            (0, 0, "origin"),
            (5, 5, "lower-right"),
            (10, 1, "right-out"),
            (1, 10, "bottom-out"),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(read_ruled_grid([0, 5, 10], [0, 5, 10], labels),
                         [["origin", ""], ["", "lower-right"]])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        rows = [0, 5]
        columns = [0, 5]
        labels = [(3, 2, "b"), (1, 1, "a")]
        originals = (rows.copy(), columns.copy(), labels.copy())
        read_ruled_grid(rows, columns, labels)
        self.assertEqual((rows, columns, labels), originals)

    def test_invalid_edges(self):
        cases = [
            ((0,), [0, 1], ValueError),
            ([0, 1], "bad", ValueError),
            ([0, 0], [0, 1], ValueError),
            ([1, 0], [0, 1], ValueError),
            ([0, True], [0, 1], TypeError),
            ([0, "1"], [0, 1], TypeError),
            ([0, math.inf], [0, 1], ValueError),
        ]
        for row_edges, column_edges, error in cases:
            with self.subTest(row_edges=row_edges, column_edges=column_edges), self.assertRaises(error):
                read_ruled_grid(row_edges, column_edges, [])

    def test_invalid_labels(self):
        for label, error in [
            ((1, 2), ValueError),
            ([1, 2, "x"], ValueError),
            ((True, 1, "x"), TypeError),
            ((1, False, "x"), TypeError),
            (("1", 1, "x"), TypeError),
            ((math.nan, 1, "x"), ValueError),
            ((1, math.inf, "x"), ValueError),
            ((1, 1, 3), TypeError),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(label=label), self.assertRaises(error):
                read_ruled_grid([0, 2], [0, 2], [label])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
